name: coppify
description: Turn a YouTube link into 9:16 short clips (yt-dlp + Whisper + FFmpeg)

scripts.install:all: npm install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: python backend/selftest.py && python backend/smoke_test.py && python backend/contract_check.py && python backend/integration_check.py && npm test --workspace @coppify/web
